# Feature Request

Thank you for suggesting an improvement to Python DSA Placement Preparation!

Your suggestions help make this repository a better learning and placement-preparation resource.

## 1. Feature Title

Provide a short and descriptive title for your suggestion.

## 2. Feature Category

Which area would this suggestion improve?

- [ ] Programming Fundamentals
- [ ] Python Fundamentals
- [ ] OOP, AI and Productivity
- [ ] SQL and Databases
- [ ] Advanced SQL and DBMS
- [ ] DSA, Operating Systems and Networks
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Coding Examples
- [ ] Practice Problems
- [ ] Other

## 3. Feature Description

Clearly explain the feature, topic or improvement you want to suggest.

<!-- Describe your idea here. -->

## 4. Why Is This Feature Useful?

Explain how this suggestion will help learners, contributors or the project.

<!-- Describe its benefits. -->

## 5. Proposed Implementation

How do you think this feature should be implemented?

<!-- Provide details or possible approaches. -->

## 6. Suggested Content

If your suggestion involves a new learning topic, mention the concepts that should be covered.

Examples:

- Introduction and definitions
- Important concepts
- Syntax and code examples
- Solved problems
- Unsolved practice questions
- Time and space complexity
- Real-world applications
- Interview questions

## 7. Additional References

Share relevant documentation, learning resources, examples or reference links, if available.

## 8. Additional Information

Add any other information that may help us understand your suggestion.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have checked that a similar feature request does not already exist.
- [ ] My suggestion is related to the repository.

- [ ] I have provided relevant references, if available.

Thank you for helping improve Python DSA Placement Preparation!
